text: The Patriots' roster continues to churn with the release of LB Jose Ramirez and OL Da'Metrius Weatherspoon from the practice squad, offset by the signing of rookie CB Al'Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad, as the team looks to maintain momentum following their stunning 29-26 Week 4 comeback victory over the Bills at Highmark Stadium—a win that head coach Mike Vrabel characterized as critical for the defending AFC champions and one powered by Drake Maye's clutch performance after an early-season slide, evidence that the Patriots' remarkable Week 4 rally (alongside the Rams and Cowboys) signals the team may indeed be back on track at 2-2. Beyond the field, the franchise will honor Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction with a halftime ceremony on October 11 against the Raiders, while Central Catholic High School's John Dubzinski earned the Patriots Coach of the Week award. Looking ahead to Week 5, the Patriots will face a formidable test against the Raiders' receiving tight ends Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer after successfully shutting down Buffalo's Dalton Kincaid in their recent upset.
